newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ has no comment on Ansett/SIA talk.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ has no comment on Ansett/SIA talk.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd spokesman Cameron Hill said on Tuesday the company would make no comment on reports that Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) was in talks to buy a third of Ansett Holdings Ltd.
The Australian Financial Review (AFR) reported earlier that SIA was in talks with Ansett's joint owners, News Ltd and Air NZ, with a view to becoming third-equal owners.
The AFR said SIA could pay between A$200-$300 million for a one third stake. The paper said the talks could take several months to conclude.
Air NZ last year bought a half share in Ansett from TNT Ltd TNT.AX in a complex deal worth A$475 million.
